versos.texto_bv: Mas, se ele der um presente da sua herança a um dos seus servos, este pertencerá a ele até o ano da liberdade; depois voltará ao príncipe. Só a herança dos seus filhos permanecerá deles.
versos.traducao_literal: E se der um presente da sua herança a um dentre os seus servos, será dele até o ano da liberdade; e voltará ao príncipe; mas a sua herança, aos seus filhos, deles será.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A cláusula final "Só a herança dos seus filhos permanecerá deles" atribui a herança aos filhos como possuidores originais, enquanto o original atribui a herança ao príncipe e a destina aos filhos; corrigir exigiria mudar o sentido (posse da herança), fora do escopo de forma da revisão editorial. — evidência: traducao_literal: "mas a sua herança, aos seus filhos, deles será"; ARA: "pois quanto à herança, será ela para seus filhos"; NVIPT: "Sua herança pertence unicamente a seus filhos; deles será".

kjv.texto: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.

vizinhos.16: Thus saith the Lord God; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
vizinhos.18: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

web.texto: But if he give of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

vizinhos.16: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: If the prince give a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance, it shall belong to his sons; it is their possession by inheritance.
vizinhos.18: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession; he shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not be scattered every man from his possession.
